actions.name: Find an existing stock component and its supplier record
actions.original_graph_relationship: Supplemental source-preparation actions; links to Preserve the input revision and state the job boundary (INTAKE-A01) and Select a supported solid feature route (CAD-10-A01). Original graph retained.
actions.inputs: Component input sheet, nominal section and existing project source manifest
actions.outputs: Exact supplier/product locator, source date and attributable dimensions
actions.prerequisites: Component identity and intended representation; external research uses the current project delegation/authorization rules.
actions.procedure: Read existing catalogue and source registers; for authorized research locate the exact stock item and retain its original URL. Record supplier dimensions as supplier claims.
actions.tool_api: Existing part_index.py and component_records.py; delegated research tools for external sources; explicit standard formula arithmetic.
actions.automation: Text/index search and identity/hash capture can be software steps; the agent checks variant correspondence and the meaning of the listing.
actions.representation: Source evidence and nominal geometry parameter records
actions.units_frames: Retain feature units; source research itself has no placement transform. P01 calculated dimensions use mm; local XY section and +Z length are bound at construction.
actions.preserved: Original documents, proposal labels, source edition, exact locator and prior observations
actions.changed_or_inferred: Exact supplier/product locator, source date and attributable dimensions
actions.checks: Variant/scope correspondence, source access status, clause attribution and source-pinned arithmetic as applicable.
actions.alternatives: Existing manufacturer drawing, product standard, supplier record or actual stock measurement, each retaining its evidence status.
